title: Earthy Crispy Uruguayan Cheese Empanadas
description: A crispy and savory Uruguayan dish featuring whole black peppercorns and a blend of cheeses, perfect for a date night, and ovo-vegetarian-friendly. The resinous flavor of the cheese and the crunch of the pastry make for a delightful combination.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, and whole black peppercorns.
Add the vegetable shortening to the bowl and mix until the dough comes together.
Gradually add the water to the bowl and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of queso fresco and a tablespoon of mozzarella cheese in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
